g.title: cluster_f
g.text: f — a PR's line in your clone (evil: gF)

g.title: cluster_ret
g.text: RET in the map — back to the PR buffer

g.title: why
g.text: a file's buffer: the mode turns on,

g.title: branch
g.text: git: the toplevel and the branch; its head on GitHub =
the push branch, else the upstream, else the same
name on the push remote (a detached HEAD: no PR)

g.title: query
g.text: pullRequests(headRefName) on it and its parent,
kept when their head repository is the branch's

g.title: chosen
g.text: the one picked with P this session,
("1 of 2" in the tooltip when there are more)

g.title: list
g.text: completing-read of the branch's PRs, open first:
#15 SP8: the clone and its lines · open · into spike/sp8-base
#16 SP8: a second pull request… · open · into main

g.title: keep
g.text: buffer of the branch shows it

g.title: f
g.text: [user] f on a diff line, a thread
or a file of the PR buffer

g.title: clones
g.text: whose remotes name the base or head repository

g.title: refs
g.text: for-each-ref in each: the branches that push to
the PR's head branch, else track it, and their worktrees

g.title: nowt
g.text: show the file view instead? (y or n)"

g.title: nofile
g.text: show the file view instead? (y or n)"

g.title: visit
g.text: visit it in the worktree, the mode on (F21)
point on GitHub's line mapped onto the buffer,
its threads unfolded (an edited line: the line in
its place, the echo area says so); a thread where
it is drawn; another PR of the branch: picked, as with P

g.title: prbuf
g.text: (opened if need be, on the same store)

g.title: indiff
g.text: the line at point as on
